people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.
translations.bsb: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them, yet they do not return to the LORD their God; despite all this, they do not seek Him.

translations.asv: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: yet they have not returned unto Jehovah their God, nor sought him, for all this.
